info.description: Health tracking and a weekly review. Every path below is also served under /api/v1/ (the stable, versioned prefix: /api/v1/status is /api/status), except Health Auto Export's ingest, which stays at /api/ingest/*. Contract changes are listed in docs/api/CHANGELOG.md.
info.title: Health Review API

get.summary: The signed-in user's account: name, email, role, and whether a Claude key is set (never the key)

delete.summary: Remove your Claude API key (no AI is used without one)

put.summary: Save your Claude API key: checked with Anthropic (free), stored encrypted, never shown again

post.summary: Delete your account and everything stored for you (confirm with your email); signs you out

get.summary: Everything stored for you, as one JSON file (never your sealed key, tokens or Google permission)

put.summary: Which data feeds you use (Apple Health, Workout Log, entering in the app)
Your training goals: primary and an optional secondary (strength, cardio, weight, endurance, health), or null

delete.summary: Disconnect Google Sheets: forgets your permission and your sheet
Turn off your Health Auto Export token

post.summary: A new Health Auto Export token for your account, shown once (replaces any earlier one)

put.summary: Your order of the Training cards, the Health cards or the Health charts, or null for the default
Hide or show the Training tab's Log workout card

post.summary: Pause your account: posts, syncs and AI stop until you resume; your data stays
Resume your account after pausing it yourself (a pause by the administrator stays)

put.summary: The setup checklist: skip or bring back a step, or hide the checklist
Turn supplement suggestions on (accept: true, after reading the statement) or off
Your Home tile order (view names), or null for the default
Set your time zone (an IANA name such as America/Chicago), or null for the server default
Your Workout Log sheet: its link or ID, checked for year tabs with your Google permission

get.summary: All feedback, newest first (administrators)

post.summary: Mark feedback new or done (administrators)

get.summary: Usage totals across users (counts only): weekly activity, and for the same period visits by device and location and arrivals by source
Every user (account facts only, never keys or health data), pending first

post.summary: Approve a user: they get in, start from the default prompt sections, and get an email
Delete a user's account and all of their data (confirm with their email)
Share your MAPS program catalog with a user, or stop
Pay for a user's AI with your Claude key up to a monthly cap (confirm with their email), or stop
Pause a user: posts, syncs, reviews and chat stop; they can still sign in and see their data
Reject a pending user (or end access)
Resume a paused user

get.summary: Program Advisor ranking for the next block: goal scores (0 to 1), total, reasons and flags per program; weights 0 to 3 per goal (default 1) change the total; available false without the MAPS catalog
The Next program chat thread, oldest first, and whether the chat is on

post.summary: Ask Claude about the next program: saves the note, sends computed training facts plus the note and recent thread, saves the checked reply

delete.summary: Delete one note or reply from the thread

get.summary: Cardio minutes by heart rate zone over 30 days, 90 days or 1 year, by day, week (Sunday to Saturday) or calendar month (default: days for 30d and 90d, weeks for 1y): minutes per zone from per-minute heart rate, minutes with no heart rate detail, and the zone bounds

put.summary: Save a daily check-in

get.summary: Check-in and drinks for a day

delete.summary: Clear the day's check-off (back to not logged)

put.summary: Save the day's check-off: each slot sent is recorded taken or skipped (slots not sent stay not logged), with optional one-day dose and slot adjustments
Save drinks for a day (all zeros means no drinks)

get.summary: What you have sent, newest first, with its status

post.summary: Send feedback, an enhancement request or a bug report to the administrator

get.summary: Health check for the deploy (no sign-in needed): status and version only
Whether Ask is on for you, and why not

post.summary: Ask a question about using the app (answered from the guides with your AI; nothing of your data is sent or the answer kept)

get.summary: Daily metrics, check-ins and drinks between two dates
Home: the setup checklist (goals, profile, how data comes in, AI, first result) and a summary: today's check-in, current program, the latest review's opening, each feed's freshness, data issue count

post.summary: Health Auto Export's health metrics (JSON, Version 2, grouped by day; Apple Stand Hour grouped by hour), stored like the Drive files
Health Auto Export's workouts (JSON, Version 2, with per-minute heart rate), stored like the Drive files

get.summary: Each scheduled job's last runs (sync, review, backup, restore test) and the last Health Auto Export posts: status, times and counts only
Lab tests by panel with their results, newest first

post.summary: Add a result entered in the app (existing test, or a new test by name)

delete.summary: Delete a result added in the app, or undo a correction (restores the sheet value)

put.summary: Correct a result (a sheet result becomes an app correction that sync keeps)
Set a test's unit, panel, or reference range (your lab report's; reset_range goes back to the typical one)

get.summary: Plateau status of each primary lift (last 42 days against the 84 before, within one rep range), with trend points
The signed-in user (google mode), or the open or demo mode
Medications and supplements: current first, then stopped

start_estimated.description: Real start unknown: taken since at least started_on, with no start event

post.summary: Add a medication or supplement (a stop date records a past course)

get.summary: Daily check-offs by week for each current item: taken out of logged slots, weeks ending Saturday (the last is this week so far); a week with nothing logged has logged 0

post.summary: Combine items taken as one pill into one item with ingredients, for past history and from now on (preview: the plan, nothing changed)

get.summary: Each start, change and stop with before and after averages (observational, not cause)

delete.summary: Remove an entry added by mistake, with all its history

put.summary: Edit name, type, purpose, prescribed or notes

correction.description: Fix a mistake in the current dose or timing; no change is recorded

post.summary: Change dose or timing from a date (starts a new period), or correct the current one in place
Start taking it again
Stop taking it

put.summary: Birth year, sex and height for age-based targets (null clears one)

get.summary: The confirmed in-progress program block: week, phase, deload or failure week, expected end (program is null when none)

What the program calls for against what was logged, per lifting day of a confirmed block (default: the one in progress, else the latest): each exercise as called for, swapped, changed, skipped or added, sets, the usual changes, and the blocks to choose from; available false without the MAPS catalog
Your program blocks, detected and confirmed, oldest first

post.summary: Start a program or training block on a day (any name; one outside the catalog has no phases or finish)

put.summary: Change a block's start, last day or status (an in-progress block has no last day); sessions move to match

post.summary: Confirm a detected program block (phases and progress then follow it)
End the program in progress on its last day, as completed or abandoned (stopped early); later lifting days leave it

get.summary: Your own programs in full, and the names of the shared catalog's programs

post.summary: Add a program of your own (checked like a catalog entry; problems listed)

get.summary: Your own programs as a catalog file (never the shared catalog)

post.summary: Draft a program from a PDF you have the right to use (Claude reads it with your AI; the PDF is never stored)
Import one program or a catalog of programs, all or nothing

put.summary: Replace one of your programs

get.summary: The prompt builder: kinds of section with their questions, and whether Claude can draft

post.summary: Draft a prompt section from your answers: a template (no AI) or Claude with your AI (your answers only, never your data); nothing is saved

get.summary: The weekly review instructions as the model would receive them
Prompt sections in order

post.summary: Add a prompt section

delete.summary: Delete a prompt section (a copy is kept)

put.summary: Edit a prompt section (the previous version is kept)

get.summary: Weekly reviews, newest first, each with its earlier versions (ids and dates)

post.summary: Write last week's review now, or write an earlier week's again (weekEnd; the review it replaces is kept as an earlier version). Syncs first; refused while Apple Health days are missing unless force. Returns 202 and runs in the background

get.summary: Last week's review: whether it exists, the last run, and Apple Health days missing or partial (dates only)
An earlier version of a week's review, kept when the week was written again
Recent syncs, reviews and other runs, newest first (metadata only)
One run with its counts and Claude calls (metadata only)
Personal settings used by the metrics, with the age defaults of the heart rate zones

put.summary: Update personal settings (null clears one; a cleared Zone 3 or 4 top takes its age default)

get.summary: Estimated Claude API spend by month and year (reviews, chat, evals) at list prices
Today, the last sync, and data check warnings as of today (stale or missing Apple Health days, partial days, impossible values)

post.summary: Copy new rows from the Google Sheets now

get.summary: Each Health tab metric: current (90-day average or latest), suggested target, the target in effect (yours or suggested), healthy level, reason and source

delete.summary: Go back to the suggested target

put.summary: Set your own target for a metric (replaces the suggestion until reset)

get.summary: Training volume (reps x total load) for the last 7 days, 30 days, 52 weeks, or all history
VO2 max readings (90 days, 1 year) or weekly and monthly averages (2 years, 5 years, all), with latest, changes and best
The Excel Workout Log to download: a tab for this year with the Workout Log columns, and How to use

post.summary: Upload your Excel Workout Log (.xlsx only, up to 5 MB): each tab named with a year replaces that year's rows

get.summary: Days with workouts, newest first: app-logged ones (editable) and Workout Log sheet ones (read only); default the last 30 days
Exercise names (yours, then the dictionary) and your own programs' workouts to start from

delete.summary: Delete the day's workout logged in the app

put.summary: Save the day's workout logged in the app (replaces that day's app workout; sheet rows are left alone)
